A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CoMAT. All 28 pages of v1 and 30 pages of v2, including figures, equations, tables, and appendices, support comparison. Relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results, step ablations, option-swapping experiments, and manual verifiability ratings in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds MultiArith results, MATH500 difficulty analyses, and inference-time measurements.

M1.justification: The two-stage algorithm and its reasoning steps remain intact. Appendix I additionally introduces separate generations for individual steps as an alternative to a unified prompt; this is a limited inference variant, without establishing that existing experiments changed implementation.

E1.justification: v2 adds MultiArith arithmetic problems and MATH500 competition-math evaluation. These extend the existing mathematical task coverage; the earlier benchmarks and English, Mandarin, and low-resource language coverage are retained.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparators remain standard prompting, CoT, and Faithful CoT. PoT and PAL are newly discussed but not separately evaluated. Faithful CoT remains explicitly excluded from GaoKao and OlympiadBench, despite its table placeholders changing to zeros.

E3.justification: v2 adds difficulty-stratified MATH500 evaluation and a timed vLLM comparison. Section 3 newly states a zero-shot baseline setting, conflicting with the retained one-shot specification in Appendix B. This changes the reported protocol but does not establish that existing experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: v2 substantially extends diagnostic analysis to mathematical subject and difficulty weaknesses in Table 2 and accuracy–runtime tradeoffs in Table 6. The earlier step ablations, Shapley analysis, option-swapping tests, manual verification examples, and step-length analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report three evaluations per option-swapping variant and the same standard-deviation reporting. The added benchmark and runtime results introduce no new repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: v2 adds MultiArith and MATH500 results. Table 6 reports Qwen2-7B accuracy/time of 46.80%/121.61 seconds for CoT and 51.20%/131.09 seconds for CoMAT. Retained benchmark scores are unchanged, while Table 1 averages change with expanded coverage. Faithful CoT dashes become zeros despite continued exclusion statements.

T1.justification: The worked mathematical derivations and Shapley formulation are unchanged; the latter moves from Appendix E to D. Additional notation for existing execution steps introduces no substantive mathematical definition, theorem, or proof.

C1.justification: v1's broad state-of-the-art and consistent-outperformance claims become state-of-the-art performance on selected datasets and competitive performance elsewhere. The conclusion specifies a majority of selected English datasets and averages over Mandarin datasets. The abstract and central contribution remain unchanged.

C2.justification: v2 adds important limitations concerning automatic detection and correction of symbolic-conversion errors and resource-intensive assessment of faithfulness. It explicitly treats answer accuracy as an indirect conversion-quality measure. New discussion also interprets MATH500 weaknesses and the runtime tradeoff.

D1.justification: Appendix I supplies the explicit CoMAT instruction template and describes unified versus separate-generation execution; Appendix F identifies vLLM for timing. Model snapshots, hardware, decoding limits, evaluator instructions, and code/data access information are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: v2 substantially broadens positioning through earlier solver-free equation reasoning and symbolic distillation, PoT/PAL, concurrent FLARE, and subsequent CoMAT-based Lean autoformalisation. It also replaces the incorrect text-to-image HELM reference with the language-model evaluation paper.

P1.justification: The six-section main narrative remains, with localized rewriting and expanded explanations throughout. The manual study moves from Appendix B to H, new cost and prompt appendices are inserted, and affiliations and acknowledgements are updated.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains a MultiArith column and a shorter caption, and Tables 2 and 6 are added. Technical appendices undergo substantial reflow from single-column to two-column layouts, examples are resized, and several figures relocate. The underlying graphics of all nine existing figures are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 adds useful difficulty/runtime evidence, explicit prompting instructions, and more qualified claims and limitations. However, its zero-shot statement conflicts with the retained one-shot setting, and Table 1 introduces reporting errors: Qwen2-7B CoMAT's English/MWP average is 57.42% although the displayed scores average 63.42%, and excluded Faithful CoT entries become zeros. These benefits and harms leave the net quality direction uncertain, particularly because the experimental protocol remains unresolved.
